service.family: Existing 248 Euler modular-equality queries from P3-07
service.query: Public p and a with 1<=a<p; decide a^((p-1)/2) mod p == 1.
service.tape: Fixed before learner randomness; public generation uses no private labels. Repetitions are mathematical-key repetitions.
service.endpoint: All-issued binary terminal decision loss; immutable prospective probability and Brier score are recorded separately.
service.loss: 0-1 terminal loss, optionally multiplied by one predeclared task price; no answer-dependent price changes.
service.purchase: Cold checked completion through the existing P3-07 adapter. Exact answer may correct the selected terminal decision before acting.
service.cache: No cache correction in the first learner; independently charged ordinary exact-cache and analytic-table controls remain available.

learner.blocks: Equal powers of two B dividing T; one uniform purchase per block, selected by exactly log2(B) independent fair bits.
learner.weight_quarantine: Weights and expert functions are fixed throughout each block; no receipt changes later predictions in that same block.
learner.experts: Finite fixed stateless binary functions of the public mathematical input; exact names and code are source-bound before a run.
learner.update: Integer product weights: K=max(2,B-1); initially all weights 1; after the block multiply each weight by K-loss_i on the purchased row.
learner.action: Compute dyadic floor q=floor(2^h * weighted_action_1_mass / total_mass)/2^h and draw exactly h bits; use purchased answer only after issuing q and the prospective action.
learner.sampling_separation: The broker holds purchase positions separately; issue does not receive the purchase flag or label.
learner.comparator: Best fixed expert on the entire exogenous tape, with all-issued expert losses independent of learner randomness.
learner.evaluation: Only purchased receipts feed updates. A separate evaluator computes unpurchased labels after the learner transcript closes.
learner.finite_bounds: Prospectively admitted horizon, N, B, h, weight-bit bound and operation/storage/output caps; failure spending cannot disappear.

resource_contract.provider: Actual existing-adapter category debits; reserve its verified cold-completion cap for every selected query.
resource_contract.controller: Charge input validation, public expert evaluation, bounded random bits, integer arithmetic by an explicit operand-word tariff, retained state and output. Record this abstract tariff separately from physical runtime.
resource_contract.comparison: Identical prices for common primitive categories; do not double-count a provider fee and the operations included in it.
controls: quadratic-residue membership table with paid construction and lookup
resource_contract.negative_rule: Do not slow exact computation, hide public structure, inflate fees, or omit controller/storage work to manufacture a favorable comparison.

primary_targets: Reconstruct the ordinary product-weights inequality and current-action block bridge independently.
Derive all-issued terminal loss plus actual query/controller/setup cost, with a dyadic rounding allowance.
Separate fixed-tape hindsight from min-of-expectations claims on history-dependent tapes.
Retain concrete counterexamples for immediate within-block learning and adaptive requests.
Check the finite implementation and price a legitimate service against its strongest public controls.
Determine a real break-even region or a scoped economic obstruction; preserve unfavorable results.
not_claimed: physical CPU or heap bound from abstract tariff
